profile.reading:
This facility, "T-Mobile Polska centrum danych" (T-Mobile Poland data center), is associated with T-Mobile Polska, the Polish mobile and fixed telecommunications operator that is part of Deutsche Telekom's international group. The prior record for this facility carried no operator name; this registry corrects that gap directly based on the facility's own name and T-Mobile Polska's well-established corporate identity as a Deutsche Telekom subsidiary.

As a national mobile and fixed-line telecom operator, T-Mobile Polska operates network core infrastructure and IT data centers to support its mobile, broadband, and enterprise services across Poland. This registry's research this session could not independently pull a fresh, detailed primary source describing this specific facility's function, capacity, or exact address beyond the general Warsaw-area location implied by the facility name; telecom operator network and IT facilities are frequently not individually marketed or publicly documented at the building level in the way commercial colocation providers document theirs, which limits available public sourcing.

No specific IT capacity in megawatts, technical square footage, or year-opened date for this facility was found in sourcing available this session. This registry separately tracks another T-Mobile Polska facility in the Szlachecka district of Warsaw; whether these two OpenStreetMap records represent genuinely distinct sites or reflect two different mappings of related T-Mobile Polska network infrastructure in the Warsaw area has not been independently confirmed this session.
